novelty: Exact 8-dimensional Boolean cube/integral over public counter bits; distinct from closed 1-D modular finite-difference and output-projection families.
literature_basis: Dinur-Shamir cube attacks on stream ciphers/public variables
scope: controlled reduced ChaCha; target-free; fixed nonce; source-orbit compatible counters only
cube_variables: low 8 counter bits; each aligned range enumerates all 256 assignments while higher counter bits remain fixed
cube_sum: For each output bit, XOR the bit over all 256 counters in the aligned cube. Packed word XOR is equivalent to 32 parallel GF(2) cube sums.
baseline: For each cube base independently compare the cube-superpoly key ANF against the single-counter output at that same base.
exact_method: For every base/round/key-width and all 512 output bits, build exact key truth tables for the cube sum and same-base single control; apply exact packed GF(2) Mobius transform; record algebraic degree, monomial support and support exponent.
stable_sparse_rule: An output bit is stable-useful iff cube-superpoly degree<=6 and support exponent<=0.75 at both b14 and b16, for both cube bases, under R6.
secondary_control: R4 is diagnostic only and cannot rescue R6 failure.
stage1_only_if_pass: Freeze fresh source-orbit cube base(s) and superpoly-solving/TOTAL scaling. Bill observed blocks, cube summation, ANF/superpoly preprocessing, storage, solve and exact verification. No alpha claim from Stage0 alone.
kill_rule: If either R6 b16 base misses either reduction gate or stable cross-base b14/b16 sparse bits <16, close this cube family. No cube dimension/base/output/threshold retuning or second development set.
forbidden: No counters outside 1..1875, no chosen nonce/IV, no post-hoc cube-variable selection, no approximate ANF rescue, no full-round claim.
